selector_intent: Inspect the compiled seed-manifest execution hint and fail if any required path array omits, changes, or misclassifies scripts/sc/tests/test_evaluation_seed_manifest.py as existing evidence.
Run the authored S10 selector with a valid detached Probe whose process launch or required input/output binding is deliberately absent.
Check the run output after rejection; fail if any Replay Result artifact is created for the missing-capability invocation.
Execute the isolated root-escape capability case through validate-package; fail the test unless capability resolution rejects before validator execution and no trusted result is emitted.

Cause timeout, import/dependency failure, non-start, or failure before validation in the detached process; verify separate infrastructure/execution classification rather than declared validation failure.
Validate the existing evaluation-seed manifest with the full-replay seed coverage selector after removing, duplicating, or incompletely labeling the named record.

Run the existing RMAP-S2 validator test with an otherwise-valid retained seed whose applicability is first omitted and then false; each variant must be rejected by the applicability check.
